name: - AnnexFinance
fix_description: In pancakeCall, validate that msg.sender is a legitimate PancakeSwap pair by computing the expected pair address from the factory and token addresses. Without this check, anyone can call pancakeCall directly to trigger liquidation logic with arbitrary parameters.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a protocol-specific multi-step attack involving a flash loan, creating a malicious token and liquidity pool, abusing a callback/liquidation flow against an external Liquidator contract, then draining funds and unwinding liquidity. While the PoC is short, understanding why the fake pair and callback-based token transfer work requires reading the target protocol logic rather than spotting a trivial bug.
